Solara — (9.1) NOVA

STARGAZER

"Something pulled her south before she had a word for it The way a compass spins before it finds its north"

[Verse 1 — SOLARA feels it, they travel south]

Something pulled her south before she had a word for it

The way a compass spins before it finds its north

The Hunter said “a feeling isn’t coordinates”

The Queen said nothing but she came along of course

The Hero asked if this would take very long

He had a thing at the fourth bell, possibly

They landed in the south in time to see

A man who shouldn’t be

Standing there.

[Pre-Chorus 1]

He was reading from a scroll

His back was to them all

He said “I know you’re there, I heard you land”

Then he turned around and froze

[Chorus — bright, wide-eyed, full wonder]

Stargazer

Eyes wide open like the sky forgot to close

Stargazer

Standing in a fold that only dead men know

Stargazer

Neither one of them said anything at first

Stargazer

She came to check the pull

And found the pull had a name

And the name was supposed to be gone

[Verse 2 — Aldric explaining himself, badly]

He said “I died — I’m fairly certain about that”

“There was a very definitive ending involved”

“And then I was just — here — with all my notes”

“So I’ve been charting. Someone has to be involved.”

He showed them seven scrolls already done

Forty constellations cross-referenced by fold

The Hero squinted — “Is that level eighty-two?”

Aldric said “Eighty-FOUR, actually, I’m thorough”

[Pre-Chorus 2]

The Hunter leaned to the Queen and said

“Did we just find a dead man doing homework?”

The Queen said “Yes.”

“And we’re taking him with us, aren’t we.”

”…Yes.”

[Chorus 2]

Stargazer

Eyes wide open like the sky forgot to close

Stargazer

Standing in a fold that only dead men know

Stargazer

No one sent him here, no one left a note

Stargazer

Someone brought him back and didn’t leave a reason

And that is the part that matters

And that is the part we don’t know yet

[Bridge — quieter, something shifts]

SOLARA stood beside him

And asked the only question that was worth asking —

“Who sent you back?”

He looked at her like she’d spoken in a tongue

He’d never learned

“I don’t know.”

“But whoever it was — they gave me a quill.”

“And I intend to use it.”

[Final Chorus — now five of them, moving]

Stargazer

Eyes wide open like the sky forgot to close

Stargazer

Walking beside them now, scroll under one arm

Stargazer

The Hunter has his belt on straight for once

Stargazer

The Hero found the thing he had at the fourth bell

And left it without a second thought

Stargazer

The Queen approved — she does not approve easily

Stargazer

And SOLARA felt the pull shift north

Toward whatever’s waiting past the seventy-eighth

With a dead man holding the map

[Outro — walking, Aldric narrating already]

“I’ll have the full universe mapped by the end of the week.”

“That’s not possible.”

“I died and came back. My standards for impossible have changed considerably.”

(The Hunter and The Hero exchange a look)

(The Queen is already walking)────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
